description: A Flutter screen widget for adding and editing financial transactions, including form fields for amount, category, description, date, and type, with save functionality integrating with a provider.

classes.name: TransactionsUpsertScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a form for creating or editing a transaction.

classes.name: _TransactionsUpsertScreenState
classes.description: The state class managing the form, data binding, and save logic for the transactions screen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the form fields with existing transaction data if available.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the text editing controllers to free resources.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Validates form, constructs a TransactionModel, and calls provider methods to add or update the transaction.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the screen, including form fields and save button.
